name: Gmail
description: Read mail, search and open messages. Refuses star, archive, trash, snooze, labels, drafts, send, replies and settings changes.
domainsNote: The profile also covers `calendar.google.com`: the Yes, No and Maybe links in an invitation email apply the RSVP there with a plain GET (`/calendar/event?action=RESPOND`), and the rule that refuses it holds only on a guarded domain.
